headline: Israel to resume commercial goods shipments after Hamas fee dispute (Reuters Oct 19)
dek: COGAT says it will resume allowing commercial goods shipments into Gaza after a days-long halt over a tax dispute (Hamas authorities allegedly demanded 10,000 shekels/$3,225 per truck). Resumption gradual, priority to essential goods ahead of winter; merchants must use documented bank transfers;…
fault_line: Humanitarian necessity vs the politics of who gets taxed: is resuming shipments relief, or leverage?
